title: Coverage Standing and the Genetic Self-Pay Quote
content:
The patient's coverage on file with Insurance Coverage & Claims reduces the genetic self-pay quote on a Laboratory Test Orders accession of the Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing class.

- When the patient has **no coverage on file with status active**, the quote is reduced by **10 percent** of the test price sum.
- When the patient has an active coverage on file **and** the accession's prior-authorization status is *denied*, the quote is reduced by **5 percent** of the test price sum.
- Any other accession takes no coverage reduction.

| Active coverage on file | Prior-authorization status on the accession | Quote reduced by |
|---|---|---|
| None | Any | 10 percent of the test price sum |
| Yes | Denied | 5 percent of the test price sum |
| Yes | Anything other than denied | nothing |

**Cases (hypothetical, test price sum of 300.00).**

- A patient whose only coverage on file has ended (status not active): reduced by 30.00.
- A patient with an active Commercial In-Network Plan coverage whose genetic accession shows a denied prior authorization: reduced by 15.00.
- A patient with an active coverage and an approved prior authorization: no coverage reduction.
